object.attr: derived: hand-off from STORE (failure analysis, common causes). git's status trusts modified time and size, so a change that keeps both is neither listed, counted nor committed. MELLON-STORE-SRS-181 tells a changed file by content for reading.
object.description: Mellon shall decide whether a file in a document folder is an uncommitted change by the file's content, whatever the file's modified time and size.
